name: player_head
desc: chibi boy adventurer with curly brown hair, a blue newsboy cap with a leaf and a wooden button, a yellow neckerchief, a cream shirt, green suspenders and a brown satchel strap
details: individual curly hair strands with soft highlights, fabric weave and neat stitching on the cap, glossy amber eyes with clear highlights, soft blush on the cheeks, neat folds on the neckerchief, crisp leaf veins
note: The leaf and wooden button sit only on the front of the cap on its left side; never paint them anywhere else.
